scientific_integrity: The proof uses an executable exact rational Bernstein positivity certificate and an explicitly credited published superunit-scale classification; no independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Cubic cardinal spline only, scale 1/2 through 1; possible historical priority unknown; continuum off-fiber argument depends on exact rational verification of polynomial positivity. The half-frequency zero intervals and their threshold were already described linewise by Hasannasab–Lemvig Proposition 4.1; new scope is full off-fiber exclusion.
title: Complete subunit Zak-zero classification for the cubic cardinal B-spline
